title: Binary Search Tree: Search
summary: Find a value in a binary search tree by going left when it is smaller than the current node and right when it is larger.

inputs.name: values
inputs.label: Values to insert (in order)
inputs.note: They are inserted into a binary search tree first: smaller values go left, others go right.

practice.note: The tree arrives as `root` (None or null when empty), built by inserting the values one at a time into a binary search tree (smaller goes left, equal or larger goes right). A TreeNode has `val`, `left` and `right`. Return 1 if the value is in the tree, otherwise 0.
